result.note: Tests the September 2026 Cabinet revision of the EPFO wage ceiling: new level, last change and coverage expansion.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) wage ceiling revision approved by the Union Cabinet in September 2026:
items: The wage ceiling was raised to INR 25,000.
The ceiling had last been changed in 2020.
The revision is estimated to bring about 5.1 million more workers into mandatory provident fund and pension coverage.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because the story says this was the ceiling's first change since 2014, not 2020. The Cabinet raised the ceiling to INR 25,000 (USD 263) on 17 September 2026. The change is expected to bring an estimated 5.1 million more workers under mandatory coverage.
questions.source: The Cabinet raised the EPFO wage ceiling to INR 25,000 (USD 263), its first change since 2014, bringing an estimated 5.1 million more workers into mandatory provident fund and pension coverage.
